messages:
sam: Quick check-in — Acme wants a POC for streaming + function-calls + strict structured JSON output. Can we confirm feasibility and known blockers?
leah: Saw their list. They want SSE/WebSocket, tool-calls to their validation API, strict response schema. We can do it but need network questions.
raj: Streaming + function-call flows supported in SDKs. Handshake through proxy needs short-lived creds; sample available. 
sam: Their infra specifics: NTLM proxy + IP allowlist. Any blockers?
leah: NTLM is the main friction. Options: customer installs our edge adapter in their DMZ (recommended) or we route through a proxy they manage. Edge adapter adds ~2 weeks to E2E POC schedule.
raj: Also, long context sessions -> recommend KV caching + batching config. For single-session traffic, aim to keep p99 latency <200ms with those settings.
max: Security asks: they requested SOC2 + KMS/HSM integration. We can share SOC2 and an HSM key rotation guide. Need them to complete security questionnaire about data retention and PII.
sam: Pricing: they asked hosted per-token vs reserved throughput for POC. They want a cap.
leah: For a 6-week POC with heavy streaming, propose reserved capacity for initial 2 weeks (to guarantee latency) then revert to hosted with cost cap. I can draft a cost estimate.
raj: Demo snippet to use in presales pitch:
```
const stream = client.stream({
  model: "redwood-infer-v1",
  input: prompt,
  onToolCall: async (tool) => {
    const res = await fetch(tool.endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(tool.args) });
    return res.json();
  }
});
```
leah: Example response schema to validate on their side: {"intent":"string","entities":[{"type":"string","value":"string"}],"confidence":"number"}
sam: They prefer the POC to run inside their VPC (private). What changes?
max: Private deploy requires control-plane peering, their KMS config (we need key access patterns), and legal approval of data-flow diagram. Ops will schedule onboarding once legal signs off.
raj: Engineering risk: if they insist on NTLM + no adapter we cannot reliably support SSE. Need explicit confirmation from them about installing adapter or allowing a proxy path.
sam: I'll ask them to confirm adapter install or alternative routing by tomorrow.
leah: Security question for customer: will prompts contain PII? If yes, recommend client-side redaction or tokenization pre-send.
security-bot: Action item created: security/questionnaire-requested -> ticket #POC-492
sam: Can someone draft a concise POC runbook I can share? Must include goals, success metrics, network steps, sample code, pricing estimate, and security checklist.
leah: I'll assemble a one-page runbook and post the link here; will also ping legal for the data flow doc.
raj: I'll build a minimal demo repo showing streaming+toolcall with model fallback to a smaller variant to control cost.
max: I'll upload SOC2 artifacts to the secure share and note KMS steps.
sam: Thanks — target to have everything ready before Thursday's call with Acme. :thumbsup:
leah: Will post the runbook link here once uploaded.
sam: Closing loop after Thu call. Thanks everyone.
